header.lede: No wars, no politics, no economic panic. Just positive, uplifting news.

onboarding.title: A calmer way to stay informed
onboarding.intro: BrightNews surfaces credible positive stories from around the world. Start with the world feed, switch regions and categories, and save the stories worth keeping.
onboarding.point1Description: Read real uplifting stories from multiple regions instead of doomscrolling the same negativity.
onboarding.point2Description: Open the original source behind each story so the feed still feels credible and grounded.
onboarding.point3Description: Keep the stories that matter to you and share the best ones with other people.
onboarding.hint: You can change region, category, and language later.
